title: The token that ran out
description: Quotes API asks the Carrier for a new access token for every parcel, and the Carrier turns most of them away. Get every parcel a quote.
instructions: Quotes API prices the shipping for each parcel it is sent. The rates are the Carrier's, a company outside your system, and it wants an access token with every rate it is asked for.
The Carrier's code is not yours to read. Select it and open its Config tab to see what it takes, what it answers, and what it limits.
450 parcels arrive, ten a second and then twenty. Every one of them needs a quote.

events.text: The morning's orders arrive, twenty parcels a second

goals.title: No token request is turned away
goals.hint: The Carrier counts every token it refuses, whatever your own code did next. Its Config tab says how many it will issue and how long each one lasts.

goals.title: Every parcel is answered without an error
goals.hint: A token that worked a moment ago can stop working. Quotes API's Logs tab shows what the Carrier answered when it did.

goals.title: All 450 parcels have a quote from the Carrier
goals.hint: The Carrier counts each parcel it has priced. A parcel that was answered with an error was never priced, and nothing sends it again.

config.name: Carrier

details: Answers 200 with { access_token, token_type, expires_in }. expires_in is in seconds.
Answers 429 with a Retry-After header once the limit below is reached.
Answers 401 when the token is missing, unknown, or expired.

notes: A token is good for 10 seconds from when it is issued, for any number of rate requests.
At most 2 tokens are issued in any 10 seconds.
